_comment: ROUND 155.20 JOB 2 / 157-A item 2. These 17 loads are stale-and-unstamped because integrations.samsara_config.is_enabled for USMCA was FALSE for their entire dispatched lifetime and only flipped true the morning of 2026-09-28 (see the guard file's own header for the audit-event proof) -- the geofence/Samsara arrival chain is correctly wired and running, it simply never had a chance to fire for these specific loads before now. The dispatcher-facing manual stamp route works too (fired once, ever, system-wide) but is essentially unused. Future loads dispatched after the Samsara toggle flip are expected to stamp normally; this baseline is not meant to grow.
